summary.text: On Tarkir, the hunter Yasova Dragonclaw leads the twins Naiva and Baishya toward Ugin's grave, sheltering the ghostfire warrior Tae Jin and trading stories of Ugin and his twin Nicol along the way.
Those tales tell how Nicol Bolas set humans and dragons against each other and came to kill Ugin, whose essence still lingers in the hedrons.

When Bolas himself appears in disguise and demands to know where Ugin lies, Naiva is nearly turned against her sister, but Yasova and Baishya bluff that the Immortal Sun is aimed at him, and he flees.
